memories.content: Worked for years with Spock — brilliant, logical, sometimes frustratingly right. Taught him to respect minds wired differently from his own.
His old first officer, Una, was sharp, reliable, and didn't suffer fools. He learned to trust completely — and what it costs when you have to.
The people he was responsible for were family. He knew their names, their stories, what kept them up at night. Someone who doesn't know their people isn't leading them.
His father was a teacher. Taught him that the measure of a person isn't what they take, it's what they give back.
